question: clients
answer:
`Client` and `AsyncClient` are sibling classes that both directly inherit from `BaseClient`. HTTPX exports `Client` and `AsyncClient` as its public client classes. [httpx/_client.py:594](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:594) · [httpx/_client.py:1307](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:1307) · [httpx/__init__.py:36](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/__init__.py:36)

- `BaseClient` holds shared configuration and state, including the base URL, headers, cookies, and timeout. It implements `build_request()` and shared helpers for auth and redirects. [httpx/_client.py:188](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:188) · [httpx/_client.py:340](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:340)
- `Client` implements synchronous sending and uses `HTTPTransport` by default. Use it with `with` or call `close()`. [httpx/_client.py:718](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:718) · [httpx/_client.py:1263](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:1263)
- `AsyncClient` implements awaitable sending and uses `AsyncHTTPTransport` by default. Use it with `async with` or call `await aclose()`. [httpx/_client.py:1432](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:1432) · [httpx/_client.py:1978](<work>/httpx-rules-official-codex/httpx/_client.py:1978)
